hero.title: We care about your health with the highest professionalism
hero.subtitle: RaiderCare is your smart university health companion, guiding you to the right health and emergency resources quickly, safely, and confidently.

sectionHeader.title: Why Students Choose RaiderCare
sectionHeader.subtitle: From understanding a health concern to locating the appropriate service, RaiderCare makes university healthcare navigation simple, accessible, and student-focused.

reasons.title: Smart Health Guidance
reasons.text: Describe your concern using text and receive clear guidance based on your symptoms, severity, and duration.

reasons.title: Safety-First Support
reasons.text: RaiderCare checks for important warning signs and directs you to emergency, urgent-care, university clinic, or mental-health resources.

reasons.title: 24/7 Accessibility
reasons.text: Access health guidance and essential contact information anytime through a simple, student-friendly platform.

reasons.title: Personalized Navigation
reasons.text: Receive resource recommendations based on your specific concern, urgency level, location, and university needs.
